items.title: Oil Heiress’s $1.9 Billion Stock Sale Sinks Diamondback Shares
items.summary: It was already a bad day for oil stocks with crude prices declining and interest rates headed higher, when a big stock sale from Diamondback Energy’s largest shareholder pushed the Texas driller’s shares down 8%, their worst day since April 2025.  The seller of nearly $2 billion of Diamondback shares was SGF FANG Holdings, the entity through which the daughter of the late Autry Stephens controls a big stake in the firm that bought her father’s West Texas oil empire two years ago.  The holding company sold nearly 9.1 million Diamondback shares Tuesday, trimming its stake to about 23% of the Midland, Texas company’s shares, according to securities filings.

items.title: Record Diesel Prices Make Fed’s Rate Decision for It
items.summary: Diesel prices have hit $6 a gallon for the first time in history and Brent crude oil prices are trading at around $105 a barrel—though they have fallen back from earlier highs of close to $110.  Consumer price index data for August, due to be released at 8.30 a.m. Eastern time, will be closely watched by investors and by Federal Reserve officials.  Cooler-than-expected CPI data later could shift the numbers and the timeline but it now seems to be a question of when the Fed will hike rates and how many times rather than whether they will.
